blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: conocer la diferencia entre needn't have done y didn't need to do
matizar la probabilidad con may well, might just, could easily
expresar planes del pasado con was to y was supposed to
usar would y will para costumbres y rasgos de carácter

head: Forma
Ejemplo
Significado
rows: You needn't have brought a present.
lo hiciste, pero no hacía falta
I didn't need to buy a ticket. (so I didn't)
no hacía falta (y normalmente no se hizo)

blocks.title: No hacía falta que lo hicieras
blocks.text: No hacía falta que lo hicieras (pero lo hiciste) = You needn't have done that. No tuve que pagar = I didn't need to pay / I didn't have to pay.

head: Forma
Ejemplo
Español
rows: Es muy posible que tenga razón.
We might just catch the train if we run.
Si corremos, a lo mejor todavía cogemos el tren.
It could easily take a week.
may as well / might as well
We might as well go home.
Ya puestos, nos vamos a casa.

blocks.text: 3. Planes y expectativas en el pasado

head: Forma
Ejemplo
Español
rows: Con el tiempo se haría famosa.
The meeting was to have taken place today.
La reunión iba a celebrarse hoy (pero no fue así).
You were supposed to call me!
This film is meant to be good.
Dicen que esta película es buena.

blocks.text: 4. would y will para las costumbres

would describe acciones repetidas en el pasado (pdf B2 · 1). will puede expresar un rasgo típico o una costumbre en el presente: She'll sit there for hours, just reading. (Es capaz de pasarse horas ahí sentada leyendo.) Con el acento en will o would suena irritado: He will leave the door open! (¡Siempre tiene que dejar la puerta abierta!)

can no tiene infinitivo ni forma de participio. Entonces se usa be able to: I'd like to be able to speak Chinese (me gustaría poder hablar chino). I haven't been able to sleep (no he podido dormir). Para un logro concreto en el pasado se usa was able to / managed to, no could: After hours, we managed to open the door.

blocks.title: Conseguí = I managed to
blocks.text: Conseguí coger el tren o Pude coger el tren (una vez) = I managed to catch the train o I was able to catch the train. I could catch the train suena a que en general podías. Y nunca I will can: el futuro es I will be able to.

rows: I will can help you tomorrow.
I will be able to help you tomorrow.
Después de will: be able to.
After hours, we could open the door.
After hours, we managed to open the door.
You were suppose to call me.
You were supposed to call me.
I haven't been able to sleep.
Forma de participio: been able to.
Después de might well: el verbo sin nada.

blocks.text: Completa con la forma correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: You ______ have cooked. I'd already eaten.
items.hint: no hacía falta, pero lo hiciste
items.full: You needn't have cooked. I'd already eaten.

items.q: I didn't ______ to wait. The bus came at once.
items.full: I didn't need to wait. The bus came at once.

items.q: She may ______ be right about that.
items.full: She may well be right about that.

items.q: There's nothing on TV. We might as ______ go to bed.
items.full: There's nothing on TV. We might as well go to bed.

items.q: You were ______ to be here at nine!
items.full: You were supposed to be here at nine!

items.q: This restaurant is ______ to be excellent.
items.full: This restaurant is meant to be excellent.

items.q: I haven't ______ able to contact him.
items.full: I haven't been able to contact him.

items.q: After three attempts, she ______ to pass her driving test.
items.full: After three attempts, she managed to pass her driving test.

items.q: The wedding was ______ have taken place in June.
items.full: The wedding was to have taken place in June.

items.q: He's ______ to find out sooner or later.
items.full: He's bound to find out sooner or later.

items.q: No hacía falta que lo hicieras.

items.a: You were supposed to call me!
I managed to catch the train.

items.q: Ya puestos, podríamos irnos a casa.
items.a: We might as well go home.
